title: Bestier L Shaped Standing Desk with Lift Top, 55"x55" Standing Corner Desk for Home Office, Computer Desk with Reversible File Drawer and Monitor Stand, Grey Wash

reviews.title: Love the desk
reviews.body: I recently purchased this desk and I must say, pictures simply do not do it justice! This desk is truly amazing. The only slightly challenging part was assembling the stand, as it can be a little tricky. However, with the screwdriver and tools provided, I was able to assemble it all by myself.One thing to note is that this desk is quite heavy, but that just goes to show its sturdiness and high-quality construction. Once set up, it looks absolutely stunning in my office.I highly recommend this desk to anyone in need of a sleek and functional workspace. It not only adds a touch of elegance to the room, but it also provides a user-friendly experience.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 9, 2023
reviews.author: Tyraun

reviews.title: High Quality
reviews.body: This is one of the best desks I have ever boughten off of Amazon. The wood is smooth and laminated and I must say very high quality. There is plenty of room on this desk for whatever your heart may desire. With this desk the possibilities are endless! Very easy to adjust the desk to your liking. I would 100% recommend this desk! Buy it now and stop thinking about it!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 30, 2024
reviews.author: Dominick

reviews.body: Cool, solidly built but the movable part was difficult to assemble.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 23, 2026
reviews.author: Esra F.

reviews.title: Really nice desk
reviews.body: Bought this for my granddaughters birthday and she loves it.  Reasonably easy to assemble.  It’s heavy.  Works great for her, she’s in college and spends hours working on homework.  She got tired of sitting so much and this worked out great.  Only one negative I will mention is one of the side boards was cracked.  Didn’t effect the stability, nor could the crack be seen once it was assembled.  But it was way too heavy to try to send it back.  I’m not sure if it was a delivery person fault or packing from the factory fault.  But other than that it was really worth the money.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2024
reviews.author: pamelarz

reviews.title: Looks great, good quality and wonderful customer support
reviews.body: I am happy with the product as well the customer service. I had a crack on the earlier shipment. The seller propmtly shipped a replacement. It looks great, is spacious and of good quality. A happy customer!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 21, 2024
reviews.author: Geetha

reviews.title: sharp edges
reviews.body: This desk is actually suprisingly sturdy and honestly a pretty good bargain. HOWEVER, it does take a while to assemble by yourself so definately try to have someone help you, but thats not even the biggest issue. The edges are SHARP I have had this desk for almost 4 months now and I have taken two chunks of skin off my knees from moving too quickly near the edge of the desk!Either the maker  needs to sand the edges down, or be prepared to put something over the edges so they dont slice you up LOL
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 27, 2025
reviews.author: breanna cardentey

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.body: This desk was simple to assemble, it’s great quality, and I just love the way it looks! Very good purchase and very good price!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 27, 2024
reviews.author: Angela M.

reviews.title: Good budget option
reviews.body: I researched for almost a year, and when I finally started working from home full time, I decided to try this desk. It works as intended and I am pushing the weight limit of the lift-top and have to use to hands in opposite corners to lift it but once up it stays up. I also guide it down, so it doesn't slam. The only drawback is not having a keyboard tray as the height when sitting is a bit too high for me even with my chair fully extended.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 30, 2024
reviews.author: RDietrich

features: 【Stable & Sturdy Lift Top Design】: This home office desk features a lifting top design that allows you to easily switch between standing and sitting positions throughout the day. Our lifting mechanism is built to last, made with high-quality materials that ensure a stable and sturdy laptop desk, even when the desktop is raised. It's engineered to operate smoothly, allowing you to effortlessly lift and lower the desktop with minimal effort

【Reversible L-Shaped & Monitor Stand】: The L-Shaped storage drawer can be reversible on either the left or right side that best suits your needs. It provides plenty of workspace for your computer, files, notebooks, and other office equipment, allowing you to spread out and work more efficiently. The movable computer monitor stand is designed to an appropriate height, providing a more comfortable and ergonomic workstation

【Customizable File Drawer】: The bottom file drawer provides a adjustable metal bar for hanging Letter, legal, A4 size file holder. The storage drawers provide customizable storage options for your office supplies, important documents, and other essentials, making it easy to keep your workspace organized and tidy

【High-Quality Materials & Durable】: Made of thickened P2 grade particle board and durable steel, won't be affected by dampness and won't deform like normal wood after years of use. With a sturdy frame, it will last a long time after putting it together. This desk is a great choice for both home or office use, with a modern and stylish design that fits in with any decor
【Best Service and Easy to Assemble】: Our stand up desk is easy to assemble, with clear manual & installation video and all the necessary hardware included.
